conditions: Deterministic corner simulations; mismatch switches disabled in bundled upstream files. No silicon or signoff result.

measurement_definitions.energy: integral of -VDD*i(VDD) over 0..7ns; one complete output discharge/recharge cycle

limitations: Source-level two-MOS cell; no extracted local interconnect or physical junction geometry supplied.
Different simulator/model preparation from original Liberty characterization; comparison is not reproduction of the characterized library.
No statistical mismatch, aged-device, routing, EM or signoff analysis.
